rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for a sofa or couch.

example.english: This couch is really comfortable, and three people can sit on it without feeling cramped.
example.traditional: 呢張梳化好舒服，坐三個人都唔迫。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa3 hou2 syu1 fuk6 zo6 saam1 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 bik1
